name: BSP_AwardTracker_GetSingleton
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Provisional; the subject is inferred from its callees, not from a symbol. Double-checked lazy singleton: cache DAT_00e198d0, allocates 0xA0 bytes, constructs via 004e18e0 under the singleton-lifetime critical section. 40 callers. evidence: Recovered scope label: the body references the literal GGame::OnInit (004e3aa0 is the only referencing function). __thiscall, ECX = the GGame object, no stack arguments. Reached from 004e5540 only on the .scn direct-load path. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_Game_DrainStateRequestQueue
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. __fastcall(GGame*). Loops while game+0x5E8 (pending count) is nonzero, consuming entries from the ring described by game+0x5E0 (capacity) and game+0x5E4 (head byte offset), wrapping when the index passes capacity.
